first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The slender dark-gray long gun held by Person A, with light-colored mottling on its surface, located in the lower part of the first-person view.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: Dark, uneven muddy ground extending from the foreground to the middle and far distance, interspersed with gravel, depressions, and wet, reflective surfaces.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: A collection of damaged gray-black brick-and-stone walls, including a nearby low wall and a tall ruined wall with a rectangular window opening.

entities.name: cluster of dead trees
entities.identification: A collection of gray-black leafless trunks, short branches, and broken stumps scattered among the ruins.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: A gray-white to blue-gray and gray-green cloudy and misty background above the ruins, with faint warm-colored bright areas in places.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: Discernible small patches of orange-yellow flame among the muddy ground and ruins, corresponding collectively to the environment.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person holding Weapon A below the first-person viewpoint, with only parts of the dark-gloved hands visible.
